title: Project Page Compiler and Public-Safe Preview Boundary
released_boundary: ProjectPagePublicationCompiler: typed compiler that accepts an L0-shaped PublishableProjectProfileCandidate and J0-shaped publication readiness/prepared-action state, produces a deterministic public-safe per-repository project-page publication projection, a compiled static preview bundle, a preview report describing public/withheld/proposed/deployment-ready status, and a frontend-consumable publication projection contract. Does NOT deploy to GitHub Pages — that requires separate published execution/approval authority.
stated_consumer_purpose: Desktop cockpit (via P0 bridge frontend) can consume the ProjectPagePublicationProjection to render project-page previews. Developer portfolio synthesis (future milestone) can aggregate multiple approved ProjectPagePublicationProjection records. Any calling service can compile a per-project page from a compatible L0 profile candidate without needing J0 live installation or Pages deployment authority.

L0.consumption_mode: Schema-compatible dict fixture — L0 provides IntakeFixture and InvestigationEvidenceFixture; R0 accepts dict-shaped profile candidates conforming to the published schema.

J0.consumption_mode: Schema-compatible dict fixture — R0 accepts J0-shaped publication readiness and prepared Pages action dicts. Live Carte Blanche installation is deferred and not required for compilation.

M0.consumption_mode: Fixture-compatible only — R0 tests use M0-shaped generated narrative sections but do not call live inference. M0's review-required constraint (all generated text marked proposed) is explicitly enforced in R0's safety and preview report.

publication_projection_schema.boundary: Dual-surface publication projection contract (project_page vs portfolio_site)
publication_projection_schema.status: consumed — R0 projections conform to this schema's project_page surface contract

completed_work: ProjectPagePublicationCompiler with typed input/output models, publication safety enforcement (secret scan, raw path detection, forbidden field guard, content-light scanner), preview report generator, Jinja2 project page template with dark theme, project_page.css, 32 tests covering safety, compiler pipeline, projection model, and preview reporting. Internal .nojekyll generation for GitHub Pages compatibility. Explicit separation of project page from portfolio site.
discovered_out_of_scope_risks: The publication_projection schema (rig.relay.publication_projection.v1) uses draft-07 with allOf/if/then conditions that make dynamic validation brittle at code-generation time — the L0 PublishableProjectProfileCandidate schema and publication_projection schema have slightly different enum values for approval_status. This is a schema governance seam, not an R0 defect.

The existing site_renderer and docs_renderer systems produce Rig Relay's own project site but do not consume PublishableProjectProfileCandidate. A future re-convergence pass could unify the per-repo project page compiler with the existing evidence site renderer.
